resources.string: German exists in two forms of address, informal (de) and formal (de-DE). If this is ticked the other one gets your text too and an override it already has is replaced. Otherwise it is left as it is.

Before an override file is changed, the old file is copied to the backup folder of the installation, subfolder language-overrides. This many copies of each language are kept; 0 turns the copies off. (Default: 20)
The old file could not be copied to the backup folder #VAR1_BOLD#. Nothing was changed.
The override file for #VAR1_BOLD# was changed in the meantime. Please open the text again.
Change how Admidio words things for your users: search all texts of Admidio and replace any of them with your own wording, for example "Members" instead of "Contacts".
The text for #VAR1_BOLD# must not be empty. To go back to the original use "Restore the original".
The text for #VAR1_BOLD# uses #VAR2#, which the original text does not have.
The override file #VAR1_BOLD# is not a valid language file. Admidio cannot read it either, so please correct or remove it.
The search expression is not a valid regular expression.
The folder or file #VAR1_BOLD# cannot be written.
There are no overrides yet. Search for a text above to change it.
Values are inserted at #VAR1#. Keep them in your text, otherwise the value is not shown. A line break is written as a new line.
Do you want to remove the override of #VAR1_BOLD# and restore the original text?
A word or phrase as shown on the page, or a text id
The texts that only the installation and the update show (INS_…) are left out of the search unless this is switched on.
The original text was changed by an update after this override was written. Check that your text still fits.
The original text shows a value (#VAR1# …) that your text leaves out.
A text may have at most #VAR1# characters.
Showing the first #VAR1# of #VAR2# texts, the best matches first. Type more of the text to narrow the search.
The text id #VAR1_BOLD# does not exist.
